top_band: blue-grey tiled roof slope (rows 1-14) above wooden pillars and basin
evidence: The structure clearly shows both a 3/4 sloped tile roof (rows 1-16, with ridge at rows 1-2, tiles at 4-14, and eave shadow at 15-16) and a 3/4 stone basin at the bottom (rows 29-43) with a visible water opening (rows 30-34) and vertical front face (rows 36-42).

style.evidence: While the roof has decent tile shading (~5 steps), the wooden pillars (rows 17-43) are completely flat two-tone bands without grain, and the stone basin at the bottom has huge untextured flat grey fills (rows 36-42, 14x6 px of a single grey tone) compared to the richly textured stone and wood in the Beodeul references. Heavy near-black outlines surround all components.
